ccl-introduction.html.text:
CCL . GACHON UNIVERSITY DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER ENGINEERING LABORATORY PROFILE / 2026 Cognitive Computing Lab . Gachon University Exploring federated learning, AI agents, healthcare AI and intelligent
              systems through AI and cognitive computing. AI, CONNECTED TO THE REAL WORLD. CCL About the Lab 01 / OVERVIEW Led by Professor KangYoon Lee in Gachon University's Department of
              Computer Engineering, CCL studies real-world challenges with AI,
              cognitive computing, IoT and cloud technologies. Our FedOps platform connects model training and operations in distributed
              environments. We study post-TAVR complication and psychiatric risk
              prediction, alongside industry collaborations and national research projects. PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR KangYoon Lee Professor Department of Computer Engineering Gachon University keylee@gachon.ac.kr Professor Profile ↗ Research Areas 02 / RESEARCH 01 Federated Learning Collaborative training and lifecycle management in distributed
                environments. FedOps connects research with model operations. 02 AI Agent & LLM Building, using and improving LLMs and Tool AI, with research on
                on-device models and efficient fine-tuning. 03 Healthcare AI Medical language models, medical twins and risk prediction,
                including post-TAVR complications and mental health. 04 Intelligent Systems IoT and cloud data applications, connecting sensor and
                multimodal data with intelligent systems. COGNITIVE COMPUTING LAB · GACHON UNIVERSITY 01 / 02 CCL . RESEARCH PLATFORM PUBLICATIONS & CONTACT RESEARCH SOFTWARE FedOps 1.3 Federated AI AgentOps From local data to federated AI agents. Train models together while keeping raw data on participants' devices.
              Use the trained models to build, run and improve AI agents. 01 / PREPARE Local setup Connect data Code · Model · Environment 02 / COLLABORATE Federated learning Join a Task Aggregate model updates 03 / VERSION Model versions Global Model Version and lineage tracking 04 / BUILD & USE Agent use Build · Test Local Chat · Serving Web · Registry coordinates Tasks, participation and
              model versions. Agent Studio supports local development
              and execution. FL Server aggregates model updates. Raw data stays local. Each Agent Build pins a selected model version.
              After validation, a new model can be used in a new Agent Revision. FedOps Website ↗ Documentation & Getting Started ↗ Selected Publications 03 / PUBLICATIONS 2026 BitLoRA: Quantization-Compatible Adapter Tuning for 1.58-bit LLM
                in Federated On-Device AI-Agent InSeo Song, KangYoon Lee · Expert Systems with Applications 311,

department.html.text:
컴퓨터공학과 연구실 / Cognitive Computing Lab GACHON UNIVERSITY · COMPUTER ENGINEERING Cognitive Computing Lab . 인지컴퓨팅 연구실 인공지능과 인지컴퓨팅으로 의료·산업 현장의 문제를 연구합니다. CCL 홈페이지 바로가기 ↗ AI, CONNECTED TO THE REAL WORLD. 연구실 소개 ABOUT THE LAB Cognitive Computing Lab은 AI 기술을 활용하여 다양한
                    분야를 연구합니다. Cognitive Computing Lab은 Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive
                    Computing, IoT, Cloud를 활용하여 Healthcare 분야에 대해
                    중점적으로 연구하며, 다수 기업들과 활발한 공동연구, 국가
                    연구사업 과제를 수행하고 있습니다. 연구결과를 특허 출원 및 등록, 국제 및 국내 학술대회와 연구
                    논문지에 다수 발표하고 있습니다. 연구 분야 Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive Computing, IoT,
                  Healthcare, Cloud 주요 연구 RESEARCH AREAS 01 연합학습 · AI 운영 Federated Learning & AI Operations 원본 데이터를 각 참여 기관에 둔 채 모델을 함께 학습하고,
                      FedOps를 통해 모델 개발과 연합학습의 운영 과정을
                      연결합니다. 02 AI Agent · 온디바이스 모델 AI Agents & On-Device Models 언어모델과 도구 모델의 구성·활용을 연구하고, 장치 환경에
                      적합한 경량 모델과 효율적인 튜닝 방법을 탐구합니다. 03 헬스케어 AI · 메디컬 트윈 Healthcare AI & Medical Twins 의료 데이터 기반 예측, Medical LLM과 메디컬 트윈을
                      연구합니다. Post-TAVR 합병증 예측과 정신건강 위험 예측 등
                      의료 문제에 연합학습을 적용합니다. 04 지능형 시스템 · IoT·Cloud Intelligent Systems IoT·Cloud 환경의 센서·임상 데이터를 활용하고, 모델의
                      판단을 이해할 수 있는 지능형 예측 시스템을 연구합니다. RESEARCH SOFTWARE FedOps Federated AI AgentOps 내 데이터와 모델에서, 함께 학습하고 활용하는 AI까지. FedOps 1.3은 로컬 개발과 연합학습, Global Model 버전 관리, Agent
                Build와 실행을 연결합니다. 원본 데이터는 참여 환경에 유지되며,
                선택한 모델 버전을 검증해 Agent를 구성합니다. FedOps 홈페이지 ↗ Documentation ↗ PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR 이강윤 교수 KangYoon Lee 가천대학교 컴퓨터공학과 Cognitive Computing Lab 이메일 keylee@gachon.ac.kr 교수실 AI공학관 312호 전화 031-750-8902 교수 소개 자세히 ↗ 연구실 문의 연구와 진로 상담은 이메일로 문의해 주세요. EMAIL keylee@gachon.ac.kr LOCATION 가천대학교 글로벌캠퍼스 AI공학관 103호 (13120) 경기도

Each node in a distributed network trains a global model using its own local data, while a central server improves the global model by aggregating node updates. Main / Research RESEARCH AT CCL Research From distributed data to connected intelligence RESEARCH FOCUS Data, models and real-world problems. Applying AI and cognitive computing to challenges across healthcare and industry. 01 Federated Learning Collaborative AI with distributed data We train models collaboratively while keeping data local. FedOps connects
        model development with federated learning operations. 02 AI Agent & LLM Intelligent systems built with AI models We study how to build and use LLMs and Tool AI, and explore efficient
        model tuning for on-device environments. 03 Healthcare AI Prediction and understanding with clinical data Our research includes post-TAVR complications, psychiatric risk prediction
        and medical twins. 04 Intelligent Systems IoT · Cloud · Cognitive Computing We use sensor and multimodal data to develop intelligent systems
        for real-world environments. RESEARCH PLATFORM / FEDOPS 1.3 From local models to federated AI agents. Explore local development, Task participation, Global Model versioning,
